display_name: 三专家与蒸馏单专家 GPU 同输入时延比较
description: 固定相同来源数据的三专家和蒸馏单专家，在合法源 IQ 上测量 GPU 修正及 DURA 加修正路径的同步时延。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, eager FP32 TF32 off, source input already on GPU; shared GPU load

data.representation: fixed source received IQ and DURA context; no labels
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 112 fixed source pilot IDs, eight each for RX4/6 or RX8 x seven views; disjoint from 32768 fit IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source-only technical latency and finite outputs, no target or identity score

permissions.claim_scope: Shared-GPU source eager correction-only and DURA-plus-correction synchronized timing, no F or target accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only final epoch5 expert mixture, frozen source-only final epoch5 distilled student and original DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen models strict source-only ancestry, matching exact 32768 fit IDs and pilot disjointness
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: All models have source-only ancestry; F/TX/V/target not used
checkpoint.selection_rule: Both fixed final checkpoints, no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7 at most one this-task worker and at most three total compute apps; shared load measured; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source or checkpoint mismatch, nonfinite output, target/F/TX access or technical failure

expected_artifacts: result.json: paired B1/B8 synchronized source wall time and parameter counts

metric_names: B1/B8 correction-only and DURA-plus-correction median/mean/p95 milliseconds
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Frozen same-input paired source GPU latency for three-expert mixture and one distilled correction
rows.purpose: Measure computational cost rather than infer speed from parameter count
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed tail-excess source G and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seed 2026092701; no training or selection.
rows.scenario: source pilot 112 records across two receiver groups and seven views
rows.budget_ref: B1 112 pairs, B8 28 pairs, five warmups per model/path, one shared GPU, no training
expected_artifacts: result.json: paired B1/B8 synchronized source wall time and parameter counts

notes: Both source-only checkpoints are frozen, use identical source inputs, and alternate measurement order; no F, TX labels, V or target.
GPU wall time is synchronized, input IQ is already on GPU; includes eager DURA context and correction for full-path rows, excludes model loading, host-to-device input transfer and classifier.
DURA context uses current eager implementation rather than official optimized graph; results do not claim official end-to-end latency or accuracy equivalence.
Shared GPU load and limited sample counts affect latency; do not infer unchanged target predictions or recognition performance.
